_readme: Booked/blocked dates per room. To block a booking, add an object {"start":"YYYY-MM-DD","end":"YYYY-MM-DD"} to that room's list, where start = check-in and end = check-out. The nights from check-in up to (but NOT including) check-out are greyed out in the booking form — so a 15th->18th booking blocks the 15th, 16th, 17th and leaves the 18th open for the next guest. Room keys must exactly match the accommodation names in the booking form. Example: "Malaya Villa": [{"start":"2026-08-15","end":"2026-08-18"}]
